question: Where are all the immanent qualities of the analogies said to be applied?
premises: Akulavīra is specified in the sense of red
All those qualities are applied there
inference: All the immanent qualities illustrated are applied to akulavīra in its red aspect.
uncertainties: rakta+artha is interpretively dense and may refer to ritual or symbolic redness
plain_english: And all of that is applied in akulavīra understood in the sense of red.
